title: Wellness, Habits & Patient Rights Guide
subtitle: Practical guidance for hydration, daily comfort, citizen rights, and appointment preparation

susSection.title: Importance of Hydration and Fluid Balance
susSection.desc: Staying well hydrated is essential for healthy bowel function and daily energy levels.
susSection.step1: Keep a bottle of fresh water nearby throughout the entire day.
susSection.step2: Drink fluids in small, regular sips rather than large quantities at once.
susSection.step3: Coconut water and gentle caffeine-free teas (like chamomile) are great alternatives.
susSection.step4: Check your urine color: pale light tones indicate optimal overall hydration.
susSection.step5: Increase fluid intake during hot weather or when experiencing frequent bowel movements.
susSection.medsList: Fresh mineral water, natural coconut water, herbal teas, and light nutrient-rich broths.
susSection.tip: 💡 Pro Tip: Set gentle visual reminders or use the Reminders tab so you never forget to drink water.

compoundingSection.title: Comfort Tips and Daily Routine Organization
compoundingSection.desc: Small routine adjustments can greatly enhance your peace of mind and daily well-being.
compoundingSection.benefit1Desc: Take brief moments during the day to breathe calmly and rest your body, easing daily rush.
compoundingSection.benefit2Desc: Keep your bathroom clean, well-lit, and comfortable to ensure an easy and stress-free experience.
compoundingSection.benefit3Desc: Choose loose-fitting garments that do not press on your abdomen for maximum comfort.

rightsSection.title: Legal Rights and Citizen Protections
rightsSection.desc: Learn about the legal guarantees and laws supporting quick bathroom access and daily dignity.
rightsSection.right1Desc: Many jurisdictions have laws granting immediate restroom access in commercial and public buildings.
rightsSection.right2Desc: Cards, patient association IDs, or doctor notes can help you obtain fast priority access.
rightsSection.right3Desc: In several places, people with urgency needs have priority in queues and essential services.
rightsSection.right4Desc: Knowing your rights empowers you to navigate daily life with peace of mind and dignity.

flareCareSection.title: Self-Care Tips for Sensitive Days
flareCareSection.desc: Practical measures to support your routine and maintain comfort during sensitive bowel days.
flareCareSection.care1Desc: On days with frequent bowel movements, focus on electrolytes, coconut water, and light broths.
flareCareSection.care2Desc: Prefer a lukewarm bidet shower with mild soap and gently pat dry with a soft towel.
flareCareSection.care3Desc: Choose simple, easily digestible meals (white rice, steamed potatoes, cooked vegetables, and lean meats).
flareCareSection.care4Desc: Limit ultra-processed foods, excess caffeine, fried items, and always consult a doctor before taking pills.

doctorPrepSection.title: How to Organize Your Notes for Appointments
doctorPrepSection.desc: Get the most out of your medical visit by bringing clear, structured data about your routine.
doctorPrepSection.prep1Title: Bring Your PDF Summary from this App:
doctorPrepSection.prep1Desc: Export a 30 to 90 day report from the History tab with frequency charts and consistency patterns.
doctorPrepSection.q1: 1. 'How has the consistency trend of my bowel movements evolved over the recorded period?'
doctorPrepSection.q2: 2. 'Are there any dietary adjustments that might offer better daily digestive comfort?'
doctorPrepSection.q3: 3. 'Which routine preventive lab tests should we schedule for the upcoming period?'
doctorPrepSection.q4: 4. 'What healthy daily habits can I adopt to maintain greater stability?'
doctorPrepSection.prep3Desc: Report any noticeable shift in routine pace, unusual fatigue, or episodes that disrupted sleep.
